newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ACC ties up with Intocast AG.
newsitem.headline: India's ACC ties up with Intocast AG.

text.p: India's Associated Cement Companies (ACC) said it signed a licence agreement with Intocast AG of Germany to supply speciality materials used in iron and steel manufacture.
Under the agreement, ACC will supply "endless ladle lining systems" (ELS) to iron and steel makers. ACC gave no financial details of the tie-up.
"Designed to offer several advantages over conventional brick lining materials, ELS has undergone successful tests by ACC with one of its key customers in the steel sector," it said.
ACC is India's largest cement maker and the leading supplier of refractories.
